title: Single Search Gene Set Browser
bodyHtml:
PIGEAN analysis

How semantic search works

Through vector-based text embedding, the semantic search module converts user-supplied free text into a list of related CFDE gene sets and phenotypes.

Click the Research Method tab to find full details about datasets, gene sets, phenotypes, and analysis methods.

To get started, enter a phenotype as free text into the search box (try the examples above the search box).

The CFDE phenotype x gene set associations section shows the top CFDE gene sets and PIGEAN-associated phenotypes that are associated with the input text, as determined by the semantic search algorithm.

The CFDE phenotypes section shows the top CFDE phenotypes that are associated with the input text, as determined by the semantic search algorithm.
